overallSummary: Fabio Giglietto maintains an active and highly professional cross-platform social media presence focused on computational social science, disinformation research, and academic opportunities. Across LinkedIn, Bluesky, and Mastodon, content consistently garners strong engagement, particularly when announcing research publications, grant awards, and tool releases.

contentThemes.description: Announcements regarding papers on coordinated inauthentic behavior and software tools like CooRnet.
Recruitment posts for postdoctoral researchers and PhD opportunities in computational social science.
Updates on awarded research grants and conference presentations regarding information operations.

recommendations: Increase posting frequency on Mastodon and Bluesky to leverage higher organic engagement rates.
Include direct links to publications and software tools in posts to drive traffic alongside social engagement.
Cross-promote major research achievements across all three platforms simultaneously using tailored tone for each audience.

platformInsights.bluesky: Yields the highest overall engagement rate (avg ~6.14%), driven by strong repost counts on publication and research opportunity announcements.
platformInsights.mastodon: Shows solid engagement among academic connections on specialized topics like tool releases (CooRnet) and methodology discussions.
platformInsights.linkedin: Generates the highest absolute interaction counts, particularly for high-profile milestones like grant funding and job hiring.
